rationale: fastdiff_flow_pixel_constrained-claude-agentic: image_size=512, pixel_spacing=0.3516, n_angles=128, n_det=1024, det_spacing=0.35754, sod=500.0, sdd=1000.0, display_min=0.0, display_max=0.5, train_n=400, val_n=200, noise_i0=100000.0, noise_sigma_e=10.0, seed=42, fd_recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/fast_diffusion_pixel_constrained.pt, fd_recon_steps=8, fd_recon_init=fbp, fd_recon_init_t=0.3, fd_recon_eta=0.3, fd_recon_dc=1, fd_recon_dc_n_cg=5, fd_recon_dc_relax=0.5, rationale=iter-5 EXPLORATORY, LAST orthogonal sampler lever fd_recon_eta 1.0->0.3 from iter-2 base (init_t0.3, dc_relax0.5, steps8). SIX-BOX: (1)PRIOR: iters1-4 all hr=0. Levers mapped: init_t (0.7->0.3: ssim 0.775->0.908, rmse ~flat), dc_relax (0.5->1.0: no gain iter-3), steps/NFE (8->16: no gain iter-4, rmse 0.0137). Recon rmse pinned ~0.0131-0.0137, 2.5x the 128-view FBP baseline 0.00521. (2)FAILURE MODE: cross-dataset Mayo prior stochastic drift - eta=1.0 (full DPS guidance stochasticity) may push the sampler off the DC-anchored FBP estimate. (3)ONE KNOB: fd_recon_eta 1.0->0.3 (lower sampler stochasticity; init_t/dc_relax/steps held). (4)HYPOTHESIS: reducing eta keeps the trajectory nearer the DC-anchored high-PSNR FBP, clawing back RMSE toward the baseline; if eta does NOT lift it, the FBP-bounded ceiling is confirmed (cross-dataset prior cannot exceed the strong breast FBP it samples around). (5)BUDGET: steps=8 reverted, ~180s, well inside budget. (6)Loop continues; iter-6 self-dispatched. After this the 4 orthogonal sampler levers (init_t, dc_relax, steps, eta) are all mapped; if all flat, iters 6-20 are regime-bound confirmations toward the HARD iter-20 stop.
